items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Zero-Day RCE (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations and has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy Rust backdoors and PHP web shells. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) to address this issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues covered in this bulletin.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any active exploits for these issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Arbitrary File Read and RCE
items.published: 2024-09-16 (Ongoing exploitation and recent hotfix in Aug 2026)
items.summary: Dubbed 'CosmicSting', this critical vulnerability allows attackers to read arbitrary files, steal encryption keys, and inject malicious JavaScript. Combined with CVE-2024-2961, it can lead to remote code execution. Adobe released hotfix AC-12485 in August 2026 to invalidate old encryption keys due to ongoing exploitation.
